name: berth-plugin-incus
description: Virtual machines and containers on an Incus server for berth hosts.

provisioners.label: Incus virtual machine
provisioners.description: A KVM guest on an Incus server, set up from berth's cloud seed. The server needs KVM.

arguments.name: server
arguments.label: Incus server
arguments.help: The address of the Incus server's API, such as https://192.0.2.10:8443.

arguments.name: cpus
arguments.label: CPUs
arguments.help: How many CPUs the virtual machine gets.

arguments.name: memory
arguments.label: Memory
arguments.help: How much memory it gets, such as 8GiB.

arguments.name: disk
arguments.label: Disk size
arguments.help: The size of its root disk, such as 60GiB.

arguments.name: image
arguments.label: Image
arguments.help: The image on images.linuxcontainers.org to start from. It has to have cloud-init.

arguments.name: pool
arguments.label: Storage pool
arguments.help: The storage pool of the Incus server its disk is in.

arguments.name: network
arguments.label: Network
arguments.help: The network it is attached to. Empty takes the network of the default profile.

arguments.name: project
arguments.label: Project
arguments.help: The Incus project it is made in.

provisioners.label: Incus container
provisioners.description: A system container on an Incus server, set up from berth's cloud seed. Nesting is turned on so that the guest's systemd comes up.

arguments.name: server
arguments.label: Incus server
arguments.help: The address of the Incus server's API, such as https://192.0.2.10:8443.

arguments.name: cpus
arguments.label: CPUs
arguments.help: How many CPUs the container may use.

arguments.name: memory
arguments.label: Memory
arguments.help: How much memory it may use, such as 8GiB.

arguments.name: disk
arguments.label: Disk size
arguments.help: The size of its root disk, such as 60GiB.

arguments.name: image
arguments.label: Image
arguments.help: The image on images.linuxcontainers.org to start from. It has to have cloud-init.

arguments.name: pool
arguments.label: Storage pool
arguments.help: The storage pool of the Incus server its disk is in.

arguments.name: network
arguments.label: Network
arguments.help: The network it is attached to. Empty takes the network of the default profile.

arguments.name: project
arguments.label: Project
arguments.help: The Incus project it is made in.
